elements_selected.content:
End-to-end verification of Phase 1. Test against the demo-vault or a purpose-built test vault:

  1. zetl index builds .zetl/search/ — JSON output includes search_index_docs and search_index_size_kb.
  2. zetl search 'term' returns BM25-scored results — every result has score, heading, heading_level fields.
  3. Relevance ranking: a page with many mentions of a term scores higher than one with a single mention (TEST-013-002).
  4. Exclusion zones: terms in frontmatter, code blocks, inline code, HTML comments are NOT found (TEST-013-001).
  5. Line-level results: multiple occurrences in the same file produce separate results with correct line/column, all sharing the same score (TEST-013-005).
  6. Heading context: matches under headings show correct heading/level
  7. Headings in code blocks are not used as enclosing headings (TEST-013-011).
  8. Index invalidation: modify a file, re-run zetl index, verify new content is searchable (TEST-013-003).
  9. --no-cache forces full rebuild (TEST-013-003).
  10. Lazy index: delete .zetl/search/, run zetl search — index built on the fly, stderr message shown (TEST-013-004).
  11. --case-sensitive flag works.
  12. --path filter works.
  13. --context flag works.
  14. --limit flag works.
  15. cargo test passes.

TEST-013-001 through TEST-013-005, TEST-013-010, TEST-013-011.
Modified 5 files (+99, -344): .hence/context-manifest.json, src/cli.rs, src/main.rs, src/search.rs, tests/integration.rs
